commit.subject: LU-20505 osd-ldiskfs: suppress LMA for OBD_FAIL_FID_IGIF
commit.message:
LU-20505 osd-ldiskfs: suppress LMA for OBD_FAIL_FID_IGIF

When OBD_FAIL_FID_IGIF (0x1504) is enabled, osd_ea_fid_set()
should skip writing trusted.lma to the inode EA during file
creation, in addition to osd_get_ldiskfs_dirent_param()
suppressing FID-in-dirent and mdd_create_linkea() suppressing
linkEA.

Without suppressing trusted.lma, LFSCK phase 1 scanning
detects the trusted.lma EA on the un-indexed inode and repairs
FID-in-dirent using the cached Normal FID, skipping IGIF FID
generation (lu_igif_build()).

With this change, OBD_FAIL_FID_IGIF fully suppresses on-disk
FID metadata, allowing LFSCK to upgrade un-indexed objects
to IGIF FIDs as expected.

Also log the repaired dummy FID and path in sanity-lfsck test 5.

Assisted-by: Gemini:gemini-3.1-pro
Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity-lfsck env=ONLY=5,ONLY_REPEAT=10
Signed-off-by: Di Wang <ddiwang@google.com>
